questions.prompt: Which command starts the development server with live reload?
questions.explanation: ng serve compiles the app and serves it locally, rebuilding on every change.

questions.prompt: Modern Angular apps default to which component style?
questions.explanation: New CLI projects have been standalone since Angular 17, and since Angular 19 standalone: true is implied, so there is no NgModule boilerplate.

questions.prompt: What language is Angular primarily written in?
questions.explanation: Angular is built with TypeScript, which adds static typing on top of JavaScript.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between ng serve and ng build?

options.text: ng serve runs an in-memory dev server with live reload; ng build writes optimized files to dist/ for deployment
Both produce files you can deploy to production
ng build starts a dev server; ng serve only type-checks
ng serve minifies the app for production; ng build does not

questions.explanation: ng serve is for development only. Deploy the optimized output that ng build writes to dist/.

questions.prompt: Which unit-test runner does a new project created with Angular 21 or later use by default?
questions.explanation: Since Angular 21, new projects run unit tests with Vitest. Existing Karma/Jasmine projects keep working.

questions.prompt: Which CLI command upgrades Angular and runs migrations for breaking changes (ng ____)?
questions.explanation: ng update upgrades packages and runs migration schematics, which is safer than editing package.json by hand.
